changes.title: Most European Cup / UCL appearances (French clubs)
changes.prompt: Name the French clubs with the most seasons contested in the European Cup / UEFA Champions League proper (from the first round onward), all-time.

source.name: UEFA / Wikipedia — List of European Cup and UEFA Champions League seasons by French clubs

changes.disclaimer: Counts entries into the European Cup / UEFA Champions League main draw (qualifying-only entries excluded). Seasons are counted per club regardless of stage reached.
changes.trivia: PSG's Champions League run since Qatari ownership in 2011 pushed them well ahead of Marseille, whose 1993 title remains the only European Cup won by a French club until PSG's 2025 triumph.

source.name: Lega Serie A / Wikipedia — Supercoppa Italiana

changes.disclaimer: Supercoppa Italiana has been contested annually since 1988, traditionally between the Serie A champion and the Coppa Italia winner (final-four format from 2023).
changes.trivia: Juventus lifted the trophy nine times but also holds the record for most runner-up finishes; the 2023 format switch to a four-team final tournament introduced Coppa Italia semi-finalists into the competition.

source.name: DFL / Wikipedia — List of German football champions (Bundesliga era)

changes.disclaimer: Only counts Bundesliga titles from 1963-64 onward. Pre-1963 German championships (Deutsche Meisterschaft) are excluded.
changes.trivia: Bayern Munich's 11 consecutive titles from 2012-13 to 2022-23 is the longest top-flight championship streak in any of Europe's top five leagues; Bayer Leverkusen ended it in 2023-24.

source.name: La Liga / Wikipedia — List of La Liga seasons

changes.disclaimer: Counts second-place finishes in La Liga (Primera División) from the league's 1928-29 founding onward.
changes.trivia: Barcelona's runner-up count exceeds their title count; only three clubs outside Real Madrid and Barcelona have ever finished as high as second more than five times in La Liga history.

source.name: UEFA / Wikipedia — Italian football clubs in European competitions

changes.disclaimer: Combines UEFA-organised senior men's competitions only: European Cup / Champions League, UEFA Cup / Europa League, Cup Winners' Cup, and Conference League. UEFA Super Cup and defunct Intertoto Cup excluded.
changes.trivia: AC Milan and Juventus are the only Italian clubs to have won all three of the pre-2021 UEFA competitions; Atalanta's 2024 Europa League triumph was the club's first major European trophy.

source.name: UEFA / Wikipedia — German football clubs in European competitions

changes.disclaimer: Counts entries into the European Cup / UEFA Champions League main draw (any round from the first round onward) since 1955-56. West German era and post-reunification entries are combined.
changes.trivia: Bayern Munich have qualified for every European Cup / Champions League edition since 1998-99 — a streak of more than 25 consecutive appearances that no other Bundesliga club has approached.

changes.title: Most Premier League seasons played
changes.prompt: Name the clubs that have played the most seasons in the Premier League since its 1992-93 founding.

source.name: Premier League / Wikipedia — List of Premier League clubs

changes.disclaimer: Counts Premier League seasons only (1992-93 onward). Pre-1992 First Division seasons excluded.
changes.trivia: Only six clubs have never been relegated from the Premier League since its inception; Arsenal's streak of top-four Champions League qualifications between 1996-97 and 2015-16 is the longest in the competition's history.
